title: Detection and Evaluation of bias-inducing Features in Machine learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper mentions religion as a generic example of a sensitive feature that could induce bias in a model, but does not conduct any measurements, benchmarks, or analysis related to religion or faith. The datasets used in the study (Student performance, Cleveland Heart Health, COMPAS Recidivism, Bank marketing) do not contain religious attributes.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned only as a hypothetical example of a sensitive feature, but it is not included in the datasets or the experimental analysis.
